name: Grouped Deck Panels
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Groups original Camelot key and phrase beside native BPM, with clear left/right deck selection.
description: 4 DECK emulator preview: groups title, original Camelot key and relative eight-bar phrase beside native BPM. Cyan LEFT/RIGHT marks physical deck selection. Keeps remaining time, overview waveforms and controls visible. Reads deck state and USB metadata; no audio, deck control, network or file writes. Phrase count anchors on first play; key does not follow Key Shift. Disable key-next-to-bpm, phrase-coach and deck-focus at load before use. MODS shortcut is a separate optional mod.
